notes: Summary: Enterprise finance customer evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for customer-facing conversational agents + embeddings for risk analytics.
Main ask: Private VPC deployment in eu-west-1 with strict egress controls, BYOK via AWS KMS/HSM, and full audit logging streamed to their SIEM.
Latency targets: p95 < 150ms for chat flows (avg 40-60 token responses), steady-state throughput target 500 req/s with autoscale to 1k for peak windows.

Network preference debate: security prefers VPC Endpoint (PrivateLink) across accounts; infra open to VPC peering if latency/throughput better. Need recommended architecture for high-throughput PrivateLink (ENIs / multiple AZ endpoints).

Firewall/egress: require egress via corporate proxy with TLS inspection, only allow outbound to Redwood Private endpoint CIDRs. Must support explicit port ranges and SNI allowlist for managed domains.
IP allowlist: security will only permit specific ENI IP ranges; need guidance on static IPs or NAT gateway approach. CIDR overlap flagged as high risk — they require non-overlapping proposal.
Audit logging: must export request/response metadata (no PII) to their Splunk; map Redwood audit events to their retention policy (7 years) and include delivery SLA for logs.
KMS/BYOK: must support external key material + key rotation policy; legal needs sample KMIP/HSM agreement. Asked: can Redwood support cross-account KMS grants and enforced key policies?

Data residency: all model inference and cache must remain in EU region; no token cache replication outside region. Confirmed Redwood can pin region for Private deployment; legal requested attestation language.

Security review status: vendor questionnaire submitted 2026-01-20 (see Drive doc). Third-party risk assessment scheduled 2026-02-25. SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence requested — AE provided cert artifacts on 2026-02-02.
POC: agreed 2-week POC. Scope: connect via PrivateLink, validate latency/throughput at 500 req/s, verify audit log delivery, demonstrate KMS BYOK flow with key material import.
Quotes from call: 'We cannot accept any persistent token caching outside EU' — Head of Security. 'Cost sensitivity moderate; prefer predictable reserved capacity for peak windows' — CTO.
Recent interactions: 2026-02-11 demo with infra + security (ff_20260211_k4b9), 2026-02-25 risk assessment kickoff, legal NDA returned 2025-12-05.
Contract: procurement building SOW; procurement wants final network diagram and security appendix to approve budget allocation. Forecasted ARR in Q2 2026 if signoff clears.

Implementation notes for SE: prepare CloudFormation snippet for VPC endpoint service + sample route table and security group config, provide iptables/proxy examples for egress, describe multi-AZ endpoint scaling.
